# Saddle Up Drinks

> Family-owned luxury mobile bar in a converted horse trailer, serving Greater Sacramento, California: weddings, corporate events and private parties. Website: https://saddleupdrinks.com. Phone: 916-224-7557. Not affiliated with similarly named mobile bar businesses in other cities.

## What sets Saddle Up apart
- One vendor for the bar, the coffee and the late-night food: alcohol-inclusive bar service, a Gourmet Coffee & Matcha Bar, and add-ons like a Late-Night Ramen Bar, Bubbly Bar and Flower Bloom Bar.
- Alcohol included or bring your own: Saddle Up can supply the alcohol under its ABC catering license, or staff the bar with alcohol the client buys.
- Two bartenders on every bar package, plus a custom drink menu.
- A converted horse trailer bar, with a portable bar for indoor or tight spaces.

## Key facts
- Phone: 916-224-7557. Email: Saddleupdrinks@gmail.com
- Service area: Sacramento and surrounding areas. Travel within 50 miles is included (Roseville, Rocklin, Folsom, Elk Grove, Davis, Granite Bay). Farther events get a distance-based travel quote.
- Pricing: packages start at $600 with a $600 minimum booking. A $200 deposit holds the date; the balance is due one week before the event.
- Full-Service Bar Experience: Saddle Up provides the alcohol under an ABC catering license. Two bartenders, custom menu, ice, garnishes, disposable drinkware.
- Mobile Bartending Services: the client provides the alcohol; two bartenders bring mixers, garnishes, ice, cups and a custom menu.
- Gourmet Coffee & Matcha Bar: booked on its own or added to any package.
- The trailer needs about 17 feet of space; a portable bar is available for smaller or indoor spaces. Generator available for $75.
- General liability insurance, ABC catering license, RBS-certified bartenders.

## Common questions
- Who offers a horse trailer mobile bar in Sacramento? Saddle Up Drinks, a family-owned mobile bar serving Greater Sacramento, with packages from $600.
- Can I book a mobile coffee or matcha bar in Sacramento? Yes. Saddle Up's Gourmet Coffee & Matcha Bar can be booked alone or added to a bar package.
- Do mobile bartenders in Sacramento provide the alcohol? Saddle Up can, under its ABC catering license (Full-Service Bar), or the client can supply it (Mobile Bartending).
- Does Saddle Up serve Roseville, Rocklin and Folsom? Yes. Travel within 50 miles of Sacramento is included.
